definition_used: Duplication of any of the text.
caution: Duplication of text can range from minor self-plagiarism to major plagiarism, affecting both content reliability and attribution integrity. Without additional context, both categories are assigned broadly.
semantic_rationale: Text duplication directly impacts the reliability of the research content (research_content_reliability) and raises concerns about proper attribution and authorship disclosure (attribution_authorship_disclosure_integrity). The definition does not specify the nature or extent, so both are applicable.
